s: Brown, blue, black moonu wire-um adhe idathula dhaan connect pannirukkom.
Appo PLC input mattum yen ON aagala?
Clue, black wire-la current endha pakkam pogudhu nu paarunga.
Adhai trace panninaa, sink, source difference-um X zero yen OFF-aa irukku-ngradhu puriyum.
Full video-la rendu current path-aiyum diagram-oda kaattirukken.
